title: Dev version closed loop not avaiable
symptom: With the newest dev version, an error appears stating that closed loop is not available. This error occurs only with the latest two versions; previous versions ran well.
cause: The directory in the maintenance menu was set to Documents\AAPS\extra, but the app automatically adds the \extra folder, so the correct setting should be Documents\AAPS only.
fix: Set the directory in the maintenance menu to Documents\AAPS only, and place the engineering file in Documents\AAPS\extra.
evidence_quote: Found the problem. The directory has to be set to documents\AAPS only. The app adds the \extra folder by itself.
